feature: A long edit plays, scrubs and edits without a stutter (pass 7)
summary: On a video, an edit made with a key or a menu now draws the picture first and lets the timeline and panel follow a frame later, stopped as well as playing: a trim with a clip picked went from 54 ms to 31 to 44 ms. Picking a clip no longer makes the Library at the foot of the panel jump up and back once for every section that arrives.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. The button on step 1 opens your own copy of the 6 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev; once made, File > Open reaches it too (Cmd-Shift-G, ~/Library/Caches/Photonz Reference Edit/Photonz Dev).

try.do: Open the 6 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev with the button below, then with nothing picked, click a clip on V1 and watch the Library row at the foot of the panel while its sections fill in.
Press Space to stop, then press B to cut the clip under the playhead.
Press Command Z, then trim a clip with a key and watch the timeline follow.
Press Space and make the same trim while it plays.

evaluate: Does the Library row stay put at the foot of the panel while a clip's sections arrive?
Does a cut or a trim made while stopped feel instant, with no visible lag between the picture and the timeline?
Is the half second the panel takes to fill in after the first pick of a clip something you notice?
rough: Bars still not reached on the 6 minute edit, so this task stays open: edits while playing trim 29, blade 46 in its own pass and 75 at worst, undo 57 ms (bar 16); scrub 2 frames behind (bar 1); about 1 dropped frame a minute (bar 0).

The first pick of a clip still keeps the window busy for about 450 ms after it, one pass of 15 to 65 ms for each of its ten sections as they arrive. Later blades on the same clip build the panel 7 times, not 31.

A blade made while stopped with the clip already picked still holds the window 47 to 75 ms, and the undo after it 56 to 66, against 31 to 44 for a trim: the extra cost is the piece the blade picks and the undo hands back, not the cut. That is the lead for pass 8.
No mock covers this: it is speed work, and what is drawn did not change (the Library's resting height is the same, only the bounce is gone).
